headline: Daemen leave Roberts Wesleyan with a first win
dek: Daemen had drawn two matches and lost six before last night, and had not won any. The record now reads one win, two draws and six defeats, and that win, taken away from home, is the only one in it.
displaced_by: results night: Daemen's first win of the season after two draws and six defeats
